text:
sam (Marketing): Need a compact benchmark narrative for the mini-launch. Outcome: 3 microcharts, 3 one-line takeaways, and a single-question demo triage. Keep hero <90 chars and claims conservative.

al (Analytics): Proposed visuals:
1) p95 vs engagement lift (scatter + trend)
2) token $/1k by batch+quant (bar)
3) p99 impact on retry costs (line + shaded)

rui (Design): I can make a social card + slide strip + a short 3-frame GIF. Card hero needs 1-line variant A/B.

morgan (Growth): Routing modal: one dropdown "Priority?" (Speed | Cost | Reliability). Map to perf demo / ROI calc / SLA consult. Add utm=priority.

tess (Product): Data excerpt (anonymized POC):
```
baseline: p95 320ms, tokens/$ = 0.025
optimized: p95 65ms, tokens/$ = 0.019
engagement lift: +18% task completion
est savings: ~20-25% per 1M tokens
```

sam (Marketing): One-line hooks draft:
- Chart1: "Tighten the tail — ~18% more task success (customer POC)"
- Chart2: "Batching + quant = predictable token $ savings"
- Chart3: "Reduce p99 to avoid retries and hidden costs"

rui (Design): Card hero options:
A: "Faster replies, better demos."
B: "Cut wait, raise conversions."
I'll make both comps + GIF subtle/bold.

morgan (Growth): A/B plan: A -> paid (perf demo CTA), B -> organic (ROI calc CTA). Track conversions separately.

asset-bot: Uploaded /benchmarks/pocX_summary.csv (sha256: 7c4f2...)

tess (Product): Legal wants conservative language: use "~" and "up to" when external. Add slide footnote with measurement assumptions.

sam (Marketing): Final ask: drop final PNGs, GIFs, CSV, and modal copy by 1766010120 (EOD). I'll assemble the launch thread + webinar slide once assets are in. Thanks! :rocket:
